w=torch.tensor(np.load('contrast_c1_out_act_k12.npy')); b=-10.4362
def dec(xi,c,delta=None,lo=0,hi=0,lab_k=None):
    x=xi.clone(); lab=None
    for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((len(x),),1-k/20)
        v,a=net.velocity(x,t,c,("out_act",),count=False)
        s=a["out_act"]@w+b
        if k==lab_k: lab=s>0
        if delta is not None and lo<=k<hi:
            v=v+(s>0).float()[:,None]*delta
        x=x-v/20
    return x,lab
